posts.title: Testing and project updates for 2026
posts.description: First impressions from a busy testing season: two new alternator regulators, Garmin’s Signal 400 VHF, the Dex7 multimeter, PredictWind’s DataHub Pro, and the Victron Cerbo MK3, plus an update on Aruna’s electrical system.

posts.title: Interesting Products from IBEX 2026
posts.description: Highlights from IBEX 2026 through the eyes of an Innovation Awards judge: Egis, Scanstrut, Garmin, AquaAmp, Pi-Switch and more marine gear worth a look.

posts.title: Egis XD NMEA 2000 Relays
posts.description: I've been running Egis XD NMEA 2000 relays on three battery banks for 5 months, and I'm very happy with the results.
